subject: VoiceMem donor mechanisms for F2 memory/retrieval/process-learning

routes.use: REVIEW_ONLY; VoiceMem supersession/downweighting supports non-destructive history but does not justify clock-driven lifecycle mutation.
SUCCESSOR_INPUT; add a separate query-activation-derived projection learner, not a rewrite of deterministic ranking.
REVIEW_ONLY; multi-prototype familiarity/identity and UNKNOWN-first evidence provide candidate falsifiers for overconfident attribution.
SUCCESSOR_INPUT; preserve Claim/Evidence/Cause/ResponseExperience distinctions without making traits factual authority.
SUCCESSOR_INPUT; response_experience -> next_time_policy suggests explicit policy candidates with outcome evidence, not causal proof.
FALSIFIER_INPUT; candidate policies need matched outcome/ablation evidence before method credit.
SUCCESSOR_INPUT; query-only semantic adapters should be provenance-bound ContextView transformations, never canonical-memory rewrites.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Dynamic slot candidates are generated from entities co-occurring inside actual retrieved memory pools. Connected components are greedily peeled and scored using mean Jaccard overlap against historical query-activation sets. Low evidence skips promotion without permanent blacklist; LLM rejection can mark the entity subset non-splittable.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Keep current WP301 deterministic retrieval intact. Add a separate noncanonical ProjectionCandidate producer over logged RetrievalPlan/query-activation receipts. Promotion must require evidence refs, bounded coverage, anti-feedback controls, and cannot mint a new fact or canonical memory kind.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Repeated retrieval may reflect ranking bias or popularity rather than a useful latent task structure.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Replay a held-out query stream with (A) static projections and (B) query-activation-derived candidate projections. Measure held-out retrieval recall/precision/token cost and cluster concentration. Include shuffled-query and popularity-matched controls. Reject if gains disappear under controls or if concentration/feedback amplification rises without held-out utility.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Subgraph candidates below the rho threshold are skipped but remain eligible later; not-enough-evidence is explicitly distinguished from LLM judgment that a cluster is unimportant.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Represent UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT evidence separately from REJECTED across retrieval/projection promotion. Never turn a temporary low-support condition into a permanent negative state.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Retrying low-support candidates could cause unbounded re-evaluation cost.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Bound reconsideration by evidence-generation change or activation-count delta; verify unchanged evidence does not retrigger expensive judgment.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: When a new narrow slot is created, memories receive an additional tag while the older broad slot remains, preserving broad recall and adding narrow precision.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Prefer rebuildable additive projection edges over destructive taxonomy rewrites. Canonical payload/lifecycle stays untouched.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Additive tags can cause projection explosion and query fan-out.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Measure projection cardinality, query fan-out, recall and precision under additive vs replacement tagging with a hard per-item projection budget.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: VoiceMem v2 replaced a mixed node layer because user traits, topics, and emotions collapsed into mega-nodes; documented examples include a sadness node with 61 items and one person node with 52 links. New traits are person-level claims; evidence carries quote/emotion/cause_id; topics stay in factual graph; response experience stays separate.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: WP303 already separates FACT/EPISODE/METHOD/PROCESS. Do not expand FACT. If F2 needs persona/hypothesis state, model it as a claim candidate that references typed evidence and causal/source refs. Response strategy belongs to METHOD/PROCESS-POLICY, not the user claim.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Adding more types could increase ABI complexity without measurable context quality benefit.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Construct a contamination suite where identical emotion/topic tokens occur across unrelated episodes. Compare mixed-node retrieval vs typed claim/evidence bindings for irrelevant-context rate and prompt token cost.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Response experiences store whether a previous assistant approach failed/helped and may include next_time_policy; they are not inserted into the user trait graph.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Feed explicit prior action/outcome episodes to WP304 as policy candidates only after WP305 matched evidence. Do not infer 'the user is X' from one response outcome.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Observed positive reaction may be confounded and not caused by the prior response strategy.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Require at least matched/repeated outcomes or explicit user correction; use WP305 pair comparisons before promoting a policy candidate.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Later contradictory situation records mark older entries with superseded_by/superseded_at, retain them, and downweight them at retrieval.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Matches WP300 non-destructive SUPERSEDED lifecycle. Keep temporal relevance/downweighting outside lifecycle mutation as an explicit WP301 temporal signal producer bound to observation/query time.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Blind recency downweighting can suppress historically correct answers.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Temporal QA suite must retrieve old superseded state when the query asks about its validity interval and prefer the successor only for current-state queries.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Relative time expressions are expanded to absolute dates only in retrieval text; donor comments report 'next week' schedule retrieval failure before expansion and recovery with explicit dates. Original user text and memory are not mutated.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: A WP306 ContextView adapter may emit a query-derived auxiliary view bound to reference time/timezone/parser identity. The canonical user utterance and memory payload remain immutable.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Wrong timezone/reference time can create convincing but wrong retrieval expansion.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Generation-fence adapter inputs; test timezone boundaries, DST-like date boundaries where relevant, historical replay observed_at, and no canonical payload mutation.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Donor code-level filters reject assistant outputs and one-off requests because upstream prompt instructions still extracted them; comments document a recommendation request displacing allergy memory from top-k. Composite request+fact text is conservatively stripped to rescue the factual clause.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Treat write-side pollution as a first-class retrieval failure. Add candidate admission/contamination tests before expanding retrieval sophistication.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Hard lexical filters may drop legitimate imperative-shaped facts.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Build adversarial fact+request, request-only, quoted-assistant, and imperative-fact fixtures; measure true-fact retention and top-k displacement.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Right-brain retrieval uses per-source quotas because high-priority response experiences/static profile could fill all top results and hide actual emotional episodes.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: WP306 ContextCompiler should consider diversity/quotas by epistemic source class in addition to cost/rank, but only if a held-out context-quality ablation proves benefit.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Quotas can suppress a legitimately dominant evidence source.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Ablate no-quota vs per-source quota across mixed Fact/Episode/Method/Process tasks; measure answer quality, evidence coverage and irrelevant token rate.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Donor comments say short-term attribution/consolidation on every ingest consumed a large fraction of latency; consolidation was moved to accumulated-new-memory/session-boundary triggers. Repeated LLM refinement was also reported as lossy for names/numbers/times, so each evidentiary item is refined once.
observed_mechanisms.transfer: Separate event ingest from slower consolidation. Trigger consolidation by bounded evidence delta or lifecycle boundary; avoid repeated generative rewrites of evidence-bearing text.
observed_mechanisms.counterhypothesis: Delayed consolidation may temporarily reduce retrieval quality.
observed_mechanisms.cheapest_discriminator: Compare per-event vs threshold/session-boundary consolidation on latency, token cost, held-out retrieval quality and factual-field corruption rate.

do_not_import: Do not create a second canonical memory/truth database called left/right brain.
Do not copy VoiceMem's biological left-brain/right-brain naming as architectural evidence.
Do not allow learned slots/traits/profiles to become canonical world facts.
Do not automatically mutate WP300 lifecycle from wall-clock decay; the accepted contract intentionally requires explicit evidence-bound transitions.
Do not let query-frequency feedback bootstrap its own epistemic confidence.
Do not treat donor code comments or paper benchmark numbers as F2 runtime evidence.
recommended_worker_order: Review existing WP300/WP301/WP303 acceptance against VM-M02/M03/M06 invariants; only open a successor if an executable counterexample is found.
Prototype VM-M01 as a separate projection-candidate producer using stored retrieval/query-activation receipts; keep it noncanonical and read-only.
Use VM-M04/M05 to design contamination and method-credit tests across WP303/WP304/WP305.
Use VM-M07/M09 as candidate WP306 successors only if held-out ablation demonstrates measurable context-quality or latency gain.
Preserve exact source/provenance and add all gains as run-package evidence, not narrative credit.
